facts.business: Midwest Ltd. is a 40-year-old mining company that explores, mines, beneficiates, processes, and ships dimensional stone (granite) globally, and is now redeploying its mine-to-market capability into critical minerals such as quartz for solar glass and semiconductors, heavy mineral sands for titanium feedstock, and rare-earth processing for EV motors and wind turbines.

segments.name: Critical Minerals (Quartz, Heavy Mineral Sands, Rare Earths)

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure for purchase of Electric Dump Trucks
Capital expenditure for integration of solar energy at certain Mines
Pre-payment/re-payment of outstanding borrowings of the Company and investment in Andhra Pradesh Granite (Midwest) Private Limited for pre-payment of borrowings

auditor.name: M S K A & Associates LLP (formerly M S K A & Associates)

key_risks: Revenue cut-off risk for sale transactions near balance sheet date
Inventory valuation complexity for granite blocks involving significant judgements and estimates
Concentration risk in critical mineral supply chains dominated by a single country
Under-leveraged domestic mineral resources not translating into industrial capability
Gap in beneficiation, processing, purification and qualification stages connecting ground to factory
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act, where applicable, and details have been disclosed in the standalone financial statements.
